name: EEGLAB to mne/raw
summary: Converts EEG data in EEGLAB format (.set/.fdt) to an MNE-Python Raw .fif file; a format conversion utility.
description: Reads the EEGLAB .set file with mne.io.read_raw_eeglab and saves it as raw.fif. BIDS sidecar files (channels, electrodes, coordsystem, events) are accepted with the input but not copied or applied by the current code.

inputs.description: EEG recording in EEGLAB format (.set with .fdt) and BIDS sidecars.

outputs.description: MNE Raw data in FIF format
